cohort: 7770 women participating in the 1973-1978 cohort of the Longitudinal Study of Women's Health
finding: Both childless women and women with only one child had poorer physical and mental health than their peers with two children, and women with only caesarean section(s) also had poorer health than women who had vaginal birth/s.
mod_finding: Women with only caesarean section(s) also had poorer health than women who had vaginal birth/s.
